item.dc:creator: Nandini Dhir

item.title: Scotland come full circle for another crack at All Blacks
item.description: Sione Tuipulotu and Scotland have the chance to end one of sport's longest-standing hoodoos against New Zealand on Saturday, writes Andy Burke. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: The young lawyers thrust onto the frontline of the domestic violence crisis
item.description: Community legal centres say they are becoming overwhelmed with domestic and family violence matters, but a new program that sends young lawyers to country towns is providing much needed relief and hope. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jeremy Story Carter

item.title: Inside the $3 billion battle over defence real estate
item.description: A plan to sell 67 defence sites around the country has become a long-running political headache for the federal government, but it is vowing to press on. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Tom Lowrey

item.title: As they battle cancer, these investors fight to recover their super
item.description: Meredith Wright is desperately trying to recoup about $200,000 of her bedridden husband's retirement savings. They are one of the thousands of First Guardian investors still fighting for their money. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Nassim Khadem

item.title: Brands asked to keep supplying David Jones despite unpaid debts
item.description: Documents seen by ABC News show the unclear situation facing suppliers after the 188-year-old retailer was plunged into voluntary administration this week. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Emilia Terzon and Katie Silver

item.title: Plane vanishes without a trace but not before chilling final transmission
item.description: In 1981 a Cessna 210 disappeared without a trace in an area some call the Devil's Triangle, creating an impact that would continue to resonate for decades. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keely Johnson, Emma Siossian, Piia Wirsu, Jessica Hinchliffe, Sharon Gordon, and Daniel Franklin

item.title: Experts raise alarm about 'safe cells' after multiple NSW prison deaths
item.description: Daniel Turnbull died after drinking 237 cups of water while under 24-hour surveillance in a prison cell. Experts warn the use of isolation cells to manage mental health risks are only placing prisoners in more danger. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Joanna McCarthy and Kirstie Wellauer

item.title: The Trumpocalypse holds big lessons for Albanese
item.description: If there's usable political information in the American drubbing for the Albanese government, it may be that there's no room for error in the era of cost-of-living pain. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Greber

item.title: Comedian Dara Ó Briain on the family surprise behind his new show
item.description: Dara Ó Briain was a "nerdy" university student when he realised he had a gift for making people laugh. At 54, his own life is providing a rich vein for his comedic storytelling. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Larissa Ham

item.title: What we learnt from murder accused's first appearance in witness box
item.description: Former police officer Beau Lamarre-Condon gave evidence for the first time at his murder trial, detailing his account of what happened at Brown Street on February 2024. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jamie McKinnell

item.title: ABC 50/50 quiz: Test your knowledge of angsty 90s lyrics, Moneyball and royals in the rain
item.description: Each question in the ABC 50/50 quiz has only two options: one is right, the other is wrong. But be warned: we might try to trick you. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Lincoln Archer

item.title: Taiwan to close representative office in Papua New Guinea, blames China
item.description: Amid the fallout, Taiwan says it will stop purchases of liquefied natural gas from Port Moresby. Fuente: Al Jazeera English.

item.title: World-first successful wild release of endangered broad-headed snake
item.description: The broad-headed snake (Hoplocephalus bungaroides), one of Australia's most endangered snakes, has been given a lifeline, with at least four of six captive-bred juveniles surviving the critical first few months after their release into the wild. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Bomb threats spread to European newsrooms after wave of passenger jet scares
item.description: Spain's foreign minister said the continent appeared to be facing "hybrid aggression and a form of psychological warfare". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Fly-half Smith fit to steer England against Wallabies
item.description: Fly-half Fin Smith recovers from a calf injury and will start for England in their opening Test of the autumn against Australia on Sunday. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Anti-fire ant eradication activist convicted after using legal arguments ‘similar to sovereign citizens’
item.description: Legal expert compares Trevor Hold’s failed defence to ‘tried and tested argument’ used by sovereign citizen movement Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast The Queensland leader of a group opposing the eradication of fire ants in Australia has been convicted of obstructing government officers, after a magistrate threw out his argument that the commonwealth-funded program is illegal. Trevor Hold was fined $1,500 but a conviction was not recorded. Hold has described himself as an “ultrapreneur”, a mental health counsellor, an organic cattle farmer and the chief executive… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Messenger

item.title: Head On Portrait awards 2026 – in pictures
item.description: A portrait of a First Nations elder by Queensland photographer Sylvia Liber is the winning image in the annual Head On Portrait prize. Head On Photo festival founder Moshe Rosenzveig says: ‘The awards give photographers from around the world an opportunity to have their work seen by new audiences, and we’re delighted to be showcasing this year’s winners and finalists’ The Head On Portrait awards 2026 exhibition can be viewed 7-29 November at the Bondi Pavilion Gallery in Sydney Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Culture.
item.dc:creator: Guardian Staff

item.title: Australia’s coal and gas approvals are starting to stink ahead of Cop31 | Jess Harwood
item.description: What happened to climate injustice? Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.
item.dc:creator: Jess Harwood

item.title: Why bandicoots and bilbies evolved such different snouts
item.description: Why does a quenda have a short, sturdy snout, while its relative the bilby has such a remarkably long one? New research led by Murdoch University's Harry Butler Institute suggests millions of years of adaptation to different environments across Australia and New Guinea may help explain the difference. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: England secure group top spot with Ireland win
item.description: England beat Ireland 68-32 to secure top spot in Pool A and book their place in the Wheelchair Rugby League World Cup semi-finals. They will face co-hosts Australia on Tuesday, after completing the group stage with a 100% record. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Three detainees scale Banksia Hill Detention Centre roof
item.description: Aerial footage shows damage to parts of the Banksia Hill Detention Centre, including to windows and an air conditioning unit, after three detainees climbed to the roof at Perth's youth detention facility. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Keane Bourke

item.title: Threatening, sexist messages scrawled on balloons left at MP's office
item.description: Threatening, sexist and abusive messages scrawled on balloons have been left outside the suburban electorate office of South Australian government MP Jayne Stinson, with police confirming they are investigating the matter. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Alleged stalker who threatened to kill jockey Michelle Payne denied bail
item.description: A 51-year-old man who allegedly sent a series of violent threats and sexualised slurs at the first woman to win the Melbourne Cup has been denied bail. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Olivia Jenkins

item.title: Ex-partner of disgraced author Craig Silvey speaks of 'great betrayal'
item.description: The former partner of disgraced author Craig Silvey makes her first public statement since he was sentenced on child exploitation charges, describing his actions as a "great betrayal". Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Greig Johnston

item.title: Australia recruit Hussey for Ashes build-up
item.description: Australia recruit Michael Hussey as a long-term batting consultant to help them prepare for the 2027 Ashes and 2028 Los Angeles Olympics. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Ireland's home straight to World Cup starts with Pumas
item.description: Less than a year away from a potential 2027 World Cup quarter-final meeting, Ireland's hosting of Argentina represents an important staging post on the journey to Australia next autumn. Fuente: BBC Sport.

item.title: Woman rescues baby koala from grips of python in Brisbane
item.description: The woman was walking through a nature reserve in Brisbane when she came across the dramatic scene. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Liz Gwynn

item.title: Asofa-Solomona leaps into crowd, apologises after 'frightening' Gallen KO
item.description: A furious Nelson Asofa-Solomona leaps into the crowd in sensational scenes during his knockout victory over fellow former NRL star Paul Gallen in Sydney. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Simon Smale
